offer: Kvitto gets small B2B SaaS companies audit-ready for SOC 2 Type I or ISO 27001 in about 8 weeks. Price: EUR 650 per month on a 12-month plan (about EUR 7,800 a year), auditor fees not included. Setup is free if the customer signs before their first audit window. Monthly plan available at EUR 790 per month.

triggers: Selling to larger or regulated customers (banks, insurers, public sector, enterprise) that send security questionnaires
Lost or stalled a deal over missing SOC 2 or ISO 27001
Recently raised a round and moving upmarket
Hiring a first security, compliance or IT-ops person
Expanding into the UK, DACH or US where certification is expected

product_info: Kvitto connects to the customer's cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, GitHub and HR system, collects evidence automatically, and generates the policies an auditor expects. A named Danish compliance lead answers security questionnaires with the customer for the first three months. Proof points: 31 Nordic SaaS customers; median 9 weeks from kickoff to audit-ready; customers report security questionnaires going from 1-2 days of founder time to under 2 hours. Case study: Fjordline Analytics (14 people, Oslo) passed SOC 2 Type I in 10 weeks and closed its first bank customer two months later.
won_deals: Fjordline Analytics (NO, 14 people): a bank prospect required SOC 2 before signing. Won because we could promise audit-ready before the bank's next procurement round.
Tallbacka Systems (SE, 27 people): spent founder evenings on security questionnaires for enterprise prospects. Won on the questionnaire help, not the certificate.
Merikivi Data (FI, 38 people): raised a Series A and needed ISO 27001 to sell into German manufacturers. Won because we support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 from the same evidence.
exclusions: existing customers: Fjordline Analytics, Tallbacka Systems, Merikivi Data
tone: Plain, short and specific. No hype words, no 'revolutionary', no exclamation marks. Write like a founder writing to another founder. Never claim the customer will pass an audit; we make them audit-ready. Never invent customer names or numbers beyond the proof points above. Max 120 words for a first email, one clear ask.
